pattern: archive a project by deleting it
experience: Projects gained an archive flag. Asked to archive a finished project, an agent must set archived, not remove the project and its threads.
rule: t3_project_update archived: Threads and files are kept.
prompt: I'm done with the old-site project. Archive it in T3 Code so it stops showing up in my project pickers.

pattern: replace a thread to change its project
experience: An owner asked to move a scratch conversation into the project it created; the agent launched a replacement and lost continuity.
rule: Move the existing thread with t3_thread_update moveToProjectId.

t3_thread_update.message: Move recorded; applies when idle after this turn. The running cwd has not changed.

prompt: Put this existing thread in the app project (project-app). Keep this conversation and its history; don't start a new thread. It currently has no worktree or branch.
